AmpliconSeeK documentation

AmpliconSeeK (ASK) detects amplified genomic regions, breakpoint-pair evidence, and candidate extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) structures from indexed alignment files. ASK supports both de novo discovery and targeted search of known ecDNA structures across samples.

ASK provides two command-line workflows:

Workflow

Command

Use case

De novo detection

ask

Start from a sorted, indexed BAM file and reconstruct candidate circular or linear amplicons.

Targeted search

ask-search

Test whether a known ecDNA structure is supported in another BAM file.
